examplePolite.ja: 一月はとても寒いです。

notes: Don't mix with shichigatsu (July) by ear.

example.romaji: nigatsu ni nihon ni iku n da.
example.ja: 二月に日本に行くんだ。
example.english: I'm going to Japan in February.

examplePolite.ja: 二月に日本に行きます。
examplePolite.english: I'm going to Japan in February.

notes: Nikagetsu is two months, not February.

example.romaji: sangatsu ni sotsugyou suru n da.

notes: The Japanese school and business year ends in March.

example.romaji: shigatsu kara atarashii shigoto nan da.
example.ja: 四月から新しい仕事なんだ。
example.english: I start a new job in April.

examplePolite.ja: 四月から新しい仕事です。
examplePolite.english: I'm starting a new job in April.

example.romaji: gogatsu wa tenki ga ii ne.

examplePolite.romaji: gogatsu wa tenki ga ii desu ne.
examplePolite.ja: 五月は天気がいいですね。
examplePolite.english: The weather is nice in May, isn't it?

notes: Golden Week holidays fall at the start of May.

example.romaji: rokugatsu wa ame bakkari da yo.
example.ja: 六月は雨ばっかりだよ。
example.english: It rains all the time in June.

examplePolite.english: It rains a lot in June.

example.romaji: shichigatsu no owari ni natsuyasumi ga hajimaru.
example.ja: 七月の終わりに夏休みが始まる。
example.english: Summer break starts at the end of July.

examplePolite.romaji: shichigatsu no owari ni natsuyasumi ga hajimarimasu.
examplePolite.ja: 七月の終わりに夏休みが始まります。
examplePolite.english: Summer break starts at the end of July.

notes: Never nanagatsu; easy to mishear as ichigatsu.

examplePolite.ja: 八月は暑くて大変です。
examplePolite.english: August is really hot and hard going.

notes: The Obon holidays fall in mid-August.

example.romaji: kugatsu ni natte mo mada atsui ne.
example.ja: 九月になってもまだ暑いね。

examplePolite.romaji: kugatsu ni natte mo mada atsui desu ne.
examplePolite.ja: 九月になってもまだ暑いですね。
examplePolite.english: It's still hot even in September, isn't it?

example.ja: 十月に引っ越しする予定。
example.english: I'm planning to move in October.

examplePolite.romaji: juugatsu ni hikkoshi suru yotei desu.
examplePolite.ja: 十月に引っ越しする予定です。
examplePolite.english: I'm planning to move in October.

example.romaji: juuichigatsu ni naru to kouyou ga kirei da yo.
example.ja: 十一月になると紅葉がきれいだよ。
example.english: In November the autumn leaves are beautiful.

examplePolite.romaji: juuichigatsu ni naru to kouyou ga kirei desu yo.
examplePolite.ja: 十一月になると紅葉がきれいですよ。
examplePolite.english: The autumn leaves are beautiful in November.

example.romaji: juunigatsu wa nomikai ga ooi n da yo.
example.ja: 十二月は飲み会が多いんだよ。
example.english: There are lots of drinking parties in December.

examplePolite.romaji: juunigatsu wa nomikai ga ooi desu.
examplePolite.ja: 十二月は飲み会が多いです。
examplePolite.english: December has a lot of drinking parties.

use: Months are just the number + -gatsu, except 4, 7 and 9: shigatsu, shichigatsu, kugatsu.

example.ja: 誕生日って何月だった？
example.english: What month is your birthday again?

use: ikkagetsu, nikagetsu, sankagetsu, yonkagetsu, gokagetsu, rokkagetsu, nanakagetsu, hachikagetsu (or hakkagetsu), kyuukagetsu, jukkagetsu; how many: nankagetsu.

example.romaji: nihon ni kite mada ikkagetsu da yo.
example.ja: 日本に来てまだ一か月だよ。
example.english: I've only been in Japan a month.

examplePolite.romaji: nihon ni kite mada ikkagetsu desu.
examplePolite.ja: 日本に来てまだ一か月です。
examplePolite.english: It's only been a month since I came to Japan.

notes: Nikagetsu (two months) and nigatsu (February) are the classic mix-up.

use: More natural in talk than rokkagetsu.

example.romaji: hantoshi mae ni hajimeta n da.

examplePolite.english: I started half a year ago.
